raw: {"analysis": "Response CBP provides a clear lane structure and gate process, but it does not explicitly address CI cost optimization or include failure-injection testing for deletion atomicity. Response TRT more thoroughly addresses the stated constraints, including running the expensive CI pipeline only once per candidate SHA, simulating mid-stream failures to prove rollback, and using a canary deployment, while also clearly listing out-of-scope items. TRT's plan is more actionable and leaves fewer follow-up questions.", "verdict": "TRT"}
